thread:
Sam: quick heads-up — ran a focused prompt-sensitivity sweep for nova10b quant bring-up. short summary: int4 saves ~2.5-3x token cost but introduces noticeable regressions on longer/codegen prompts.
Maria: cool, can you drop the topline numbers and slices tested?
Sam: ran 6k eval prompts across single-turn QA, multi-turn chat snippets, and code-gen. seq cap 1024. aggregates: INT8 (baseline) — EM 86.4, MRR 0.872, top-tail median drop 0.9%, cost ≈ $11.8/1M tokens. INT4 (dynamic) — EM 84.1, MRR 0.846, top-tail median drop 3.3%, cost ≈ $4.4/1M tokens.
Priya: so ~2.3 EM points on avg. where are the worst drops?
Sam: code-gen with >200 token outputs sees 5–9% correctness proxy loss on int4. short QA (<50 tokens) is ~0.5–1% drop. multi-turn dialog shows varied drift depending on long-range coherence.
Kevin: share the bench command?
Sam: used: 
```
bench-eval --model nova10b --quant {int8,int4} --batch 1 --seq 1024 --prompts evalset_v2.csv --metrics em,mrr,latency
```
Sam: sample rows (prompt_id,quant,em,mrr,lat_ms):
```
12345,int8,1.0,1.0,210
12345,int4,0.0,0.0,195
54321,int8,0.8,0.84,220
54321,int4,0.75,0.78,200
```
Julia: latency is same/slightly better with int4, so perf isn't the blocker. it's quality.
Priya: product question: can we hybrid-route? maybe int4 default and int8 for risky slices?
Sam: proposal: default int4 for low-risk routes (short QA, embeddings, bulk summarization). route to int8 for code-gen, long-context (>512 tokens), and premium customers. add fallback: if int4 confidence proxy <0.7 rerun on int8.
Kevin: unit-econ impact with that routing? rough numbers pls.
Sam: using our traffic mix (60% short QA, 25% summarization, 10% code-gen, 5% premium): all-int8 cost baseline $11.8/1M. all-int4 $4.4/1M. hybrid (int4 default + int8 for ~15% calls after signals) ≈ 0.85*4.4 + 0.15*(4.4 + extra rerun cost) ≈ $5.5/1M (ballpark). ~53% reduction vs all-int8.
Maria: need quality guardrails; what's the signal quality?
Sam: tested two simple signals: prompt length and token-patterns (contains ``` or keywords like "implement"). a tiny classifier combining these recovers ~80% of cases where int4 fails badly. precision ~0.78.
Julia: any calibration shift in confidence with int4?
Sam: yes small shift. we recalibrated per-quant-level (avg shift ~0.03). after recalib threshold 0.7 works reasonably.
Priya: product idea: expose "cost-saver" toggle for GTN/pilot customers with clear SLOs and opt-out for codegen.
Kevin: ops: will need rollout flags and dashboards: per-route EM, rerun rate, extra latency P95. recommend 5% canary for 48h.
deploy-bot: Canary flag created: flag=ml.quant.hybrid.nova10b, bucket=5%, duration=48h
Sam: next actions: 1) instrument per-prompt signal + rerun counter (Sam), 2) add canary config + dashboards (Kevin), 3) product messaging + opt-outs (Priya), 4) finalize unit-econ writeup & sensitivity (Maria).
Priya: I'll draft product blurb: "Try cost-saver quant routing (int4 default) — estimated ~2x cost reduction. Toggle off for codegen/premium."
Maria: I'll own the unit-econ doc and include sensitivity bands for rerun rates (0–25%).
Kevin: I'll wire observability: rerun_rate, int4->int8 fallback ratio, P95 latency delta, per-slice EM.
Sam: I'll put full bench CSV and config on eng-ml drive, ping me for access. :thumbsup:
Julia: actionable. reconvene after 48h canary to decide rollout expand/rollback?
Sam: scheduled check-in 2.5 days after canary ends.
Priya: tagging @product-leads for awareness.
